content.description: Our society will be two fold. The first aspect is a society of highly sophisticated crypto apes that help each other find opportunities, create new ventures, work together to improve the overall ADA ecosystem, and most importantly have fun. The second aspect, that we are revealing for the first time today, is a Utility for the collection. We will be launching an NFT escrow tool. This will allow you trade your NFTs with other users. For example, say have you an extra Yummi and want to trade with somebody for a Goat.
